title: Reading Drill — Separating Cargo and Passenger Traffic
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Separating Cargo and Passenger Traffic
passages.body:
**A** A port manager noticed that foot passengers often crossed the route used by delivery vehicles. Staff used hand-held counters to identify the busiest periods rather than relying on the ferry timetable.

**B** A temporary line of barriers redirected people away from the loading area. However, it added extra walking for some passengers and staff found that the length mattered more when people carried heavy bags.

**C** The manager adjusted the route and opened a more direct passage during quiet periods. Each opening still required a member of staff to check the vehicle lane first.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Staff used hand-held counters to identify the busiest periods rather than relying on the ferry timetable.
